dslRule:
<!id: redundant.instanceof.to.notnull>
<!description: Replaces a redundant 'instanceof' check with '!= null' when the variable's static type is already a subtype of the checked type.>
<!severity: HINT>
if ($x instanceof $Type) :: subtypeOf($x, $Type)
=>
if ($x != null)
;;
summary: Replaces redundant 'instanceof' checks with '!= null' for variables whose static type already guarantees the check.
